data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, MINOR): the contract doc (plugins/dso/docs/contracts/migration-class-marker.md) is the NORMATIVE single source for the marker JSON schema; task-3 (emitter) and task-4 (consumer wiring) must conform to it rather than redefining the shape.
